diagnosis: Candidate/bad runs overrepeat interactions after receiving unchanged results, especially repeated clicks, no-ops, and scrolling.
expected_mechanism: Detecting unchanged state forces strategy revision before further actions, reducing loops and wasted operations. Cost: state comparison and occasional premature switching when repetition is legitimately necessary.
policy_text: Track whether each action produces a material state change. After two equivalent actions or observations yield unchanged results, do not repeat them unchanged; explicitly revise the hypothesis, target, parameters, or strategy. Resume repetition only when new evidence explains why it should succeed.

quantitative_evidence.finding: Repeated-result operations show +1,261 candidate/bad excess, 11.31% of the signed total. Within this excess, clicks contribute +639, no-ops +356, and scrolls +277.
Inspection has +1,531 net excess operations; repeated results account for +602, nearly matching its +672 progress results.
Traces reproduce consecutive candidate-side repetitions: the same search click appears at steps 0006–0007, while the same buy_tickets click recurs across many steps including 0014–0021.
